import sys
import random

MOD = 1000000007

def dfs(node, tree):
    if not tree[node]:
        return (2, 2)
    
    total_ways = 1
    total_colors = 1
    
    ways_asc = 1
    ways_desc = 1
    
    for child in tree[node]:
        child_ways, child_colors = dfs(child, tree)
        ways_asc = (ways_asc * child_ways) % MOD
        ways_desc = (ways_desc * child_ways) % MOD
        total_colors = (total_colors * child_colors) % MOD
    
    total_ways = (total_ways * (ways_asc + ways_desc)) % MOD
    total_colors = (total_colors * 3) % MOD
    
    return (total_ways, total_colors)

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    parents = list(map(int, input[1:]))
    
    tree = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for i in range(1, n):
        tree[parents[i]].append(i + 1)
    
    ways, colors = dfs(1, tree)
    print((ways - colors + MOD) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
